RT-PCR.readouts: SARS-CoV-2 RNA concentrations, virus RNA copies

evidence_location.quote: For both Cohort A and B, there was no difference by sex in terms of viral RNA concentrations in nasopharyngeal swab and saliva.

ELISA.readouts: anti-SARS-CoV-2 S1-specific IgG and IgM antibody titers

evidence_location.quote: Anti-SARS-CoV-2 S1-specific IgG and IgM (anti-S1-IgG and -IgM) antibodies were comparable in infected men and women in Cohort A ( Fig. 1b ) and Cohort B .
However, IL-8 and IL-18 were significantly higher in male patients compared to female patients in Cohort A ( Fig. 1c ).

flow cytometry.readouts: PBMC composition, monocyte subsets, T cell frequencies, activated T cells, terminally differentiated T cells, intracellular cytokine-positive T cells

evidence_location.quote: In contrast, female patients mounted significantly more robust T cell activation than male patients during SARS-CoV-2 infection, which was sustained in old age.

T cell intracellular staining.readouts: IFNγ, Granzyme B, TNF, IL-6, IL-2, IL-17A positive T-cell frequencies
